title: Wanna Throw a Birthday Party

nodes.speaker: Banor
nodes.text: Hey boss. Was hoping to find you here.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey boss. Was hoping to find you here.

nodes.speaker: Banor
nodes.text: Come on, boss. Gotta have more faith than that. Things are running smooth as the bottom of a jar fresh outta the spinner.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Come on, boss. Gotta have more faith than that. Things are running smooth as the bottom of a jar fresh outta the spinner.

nodes.speaker: Banor
nodes.text: I think we need to expand. Really reach out into the city and see what we can get our hands on.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I think we need to expand. Really reach out into the city and see what we can get our hands on.

nodes.speaker: Banor
nodes.text: Now see, I disagree. I think we can take on as much as we can shoulder and lemme tell you, we got some muscles beggin' for some more.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Now see, I disagree. I think we can take on as much as we can shoulder and lemme tell you, we got some muscles beggin' for some more.

nodes.speaker: Banor
nodes.text: Saw a friend of mine the other day. Talkin' all kinds of things.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Saw a friend of mine the other day. Talkin' all kinds of things.

nodes.speaker: Banor
nodes.text: A Tier 3 LICCY up for grabs. Said the owner's no showed for a few weeks now. Rent's due and there's just one bartender left trying to hold onto the place.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A Tier 3 LICCY up for grabs. Said the owner's no showed for a few weeks now. Rent's due and there's just one bartender left trying to hold onto the place.

nodes.speaker: Banor
nodes.text: I think you got a keen business sense. And I also think my friend was a little drunk when he came knocking. Said you can get the place just for throwing a birthday party.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I think you got a keen business sense. And I also think my friend was a little drunk when he came knocking. Said you can get the place just for throwing a birthday party.

nodes.speaker: Banor
nodes.text: I don't know. Talk to the bartender. Ziggy.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't know. Talk to the bartender. Ziggy.

nodes.speaker: Banor
nodes.text: The place is called Odin's Pub, down in the Industrial whatever. Probably made of shipping containers, ha!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The place is called Odin's Pub, down in the Industrial whatever. Probably made of shipping containers, ha!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What's going on?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So what's going on?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So what's going on?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sounds good. What are you thinking?

pronounText.TextSheVersion: Sounds good. What are you thinking?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Sounds good. What are you thinking?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don't think we should overstretch.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't think we should overstretch.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I don't think we should overstretch.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I don't think we should overstretch.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Like what things?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Like what things?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sounds like 'Sec's already got their eyes on it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sounds like 'Sec's already got their eyes on it.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Sounds like 'Sec's already got their eyes on it.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Sounds like 'Sec's already got their eyes on it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You think it's worth the work?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You think it's worth the work?

pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You think it's worth the work?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm sorry, what?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Ziggy? He's the bartender?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ziggy? He's the bartender?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Where can I find him?
